summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine share buy-back purchase on 4 September 2026, executed by BNP Paribas under its 5 August 2026 buy-back program. It purchased 10,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of GBP 15.7087 (high GBP 15.8060, low GBP 15.6240) and 409,200 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at a volume-weighted average price of HK$166.7935. Since commencement, 26,035,414 shares were repurchased for US$536.4 million, all for cancellation. No board recommendation or advisors are relevant. Watch for continued program updates and potential share count reduction effects; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is an ongoing capital-return transaction.
